title: Zun`Muram Mordl Delt
summary: Mordl Delt divides into images whose deaths determine his health when he reforms.
overview: Mordl Delt divides into images whose deaths determine his health when he reforms.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Assign each image to a tank and focus kills during the timed split windows.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: At 90%, 70% and 50%, the boss becomes inactive and splits into two, three and four images.
Defeat the images to force his return, or survive until the three-minute split timer expires. Kills reduce the reformed boss's health.
At 30%, two additional images appear while the main body stays active and hits harder.

notes: Approval E335. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
